title: Korean Culture & Traditions
description: Holidays, customs, food, and traditional Korean life

items.translation: Chuseok (Korean Thanksgiving)
Seollal (Lunar New Year)
Hanbok (Traditional Korean clothing)
Tteokguk (Rice cake soup)
Songpyeon (Half-moon rice cakes)
Hanok (Traditional Korean house)
Have a wonderful Chuseok holiday.
Happy Lunar New Year!
On New Year's Day, we eat rice cake soup.
On Chuseok, we make half-moon rice cakes.
Hanbok is traditional Korean clothing.
Hanok is a traditional Korean house.
Kimjang culture is a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage.
Taegeukgi is the national flag of Korea.
Rose of Sharon is the national flower of Korea.
Gyeongbokgung is a royal palace of the Joseon Dynasty.

items.target: 남산타워에서 서울 야경을 볼 수 있습니다.
items.translation: You can see the night view of Seoul from Namsan Tower.
Jeju Island is the largest island in Korea.

items.target: 한라산은 제주도에 있는 높고 아름다운 산입니다.
items.translation: Hallasan is a tall and beautiful mountain on Jeju Island.

items.target: 한강은 서울 시내를 지나는 아름다운 강입니다.
items.translation: The Han River is a beautiful river running through downtown Seoul.
Dongdaemun Design Plaza is a landmark of modern architecture.
Hongdae is a street of youth and art.

items.target: 인사동에서 전통 차를 마실 수 있습니다.
items.translation: You can drink traditional tea in Insadong.

items.target: 북촌한옥마을은 전통 한옥이 잘 보존된 곳입니다.
items.translation: Bukchon Hanok Village is a well-preserved traditional hanok area.

items.target: 전주한옥마을에서 맛있는 비빔밥을 먹을 수 있습니다.
items.translation: You can eat delicious bibimbap in Jeonju Hanok Village.
Haeundae in Busan is a famous beach.
Bulguksa and Seokguram are Gyeongju's representative cultural heritage.
Pansori is traditional Korean musical storytelling art.
Samulnori is a performance using four traditional percussion instruments.
Talchum is traditional Korean mask dance.
Ssireum is traditional Korean folk wrestling.
Hanji is traditional Korean paper.
Onggi is traditional Korean earthenware.
Makgeolli is traditional Korean rice wine.

items.target: 소주는 한국에서 가장 인기 있는 음료입니다.
items.translation: Soju is the most popular distilled beverage in Korea.
Chimaek is the pairing of fried chicken and beer.
Street foods include tteokbokki and fish cakes.
Bungeoppang is an iconic winter street snack.
Hotteok is a sweet, chewy filled pancake.
People eat delicious late-night snacks at street carts (pojangmacha).
People relax warmly in a Korean bathhouse (jjimjilbang).
People sing songs with friends at a noraebang (karaoke).
People enjoy high-spec games at a PC bang.
Food delivery culture is extremely developed in Korea.
Happy New Year! (Lit: May you receive much luck in the New Year!)
Have a joyful Chuseok holiday!
Welcome to Korea!
Let's experience Korean culture together.

items.target: 한국은 전통과 현대가 조화를 이루는 곳입니다.
items.translation: Korea is a place where tradition and modernity harmonize.
Please enjoy the diverse aspects of Korean culture!
